text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes, a mocktail bar opens in the 
cafeteria exclusively during lunch break. 
The name of that bar is――"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to "Cheers to Gimlet." In this 
establishment, there are no chains of 
constraint. Only a one-of-a-kind nectar 
tailored for each guest...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day. May I have a glass? Tell me, how 
do I look in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, what an inquisitive young lady. 
Is fearlessness in seeking knowledge a 
divine nobility? Or perhaps a purity 
nurtured by the Emerald Isle...?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet that unfathomable smile hints at 
something more... Heh heh... This must be 
it. A single spoonful added to a classic, 
time-honored flavor...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A "Shamrock"...! An arranged mocktail 
infused with pure chaos...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a beautiful shade of green... 
Down the hatch. ...Ah! This flavor... It 
feels somewhat...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm craving chashu pork! It looks like 
it'd go so well with something savory♪

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd say that, so I came 
prepared. You are no mere sheltered 
princess. This drink represents that...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Master! One drink for me too, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how exciting! I don't really have a 
very distinctive personality, so it might 
be hard to pinpoint my traits, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What nonsense. There is no such thing as 
someone without individuality.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I can tell... The bounty of mother ocean 
and white fruit, with fresh snow lining 
the rim of the glass...! The fine drink 
befitting you now... is this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Delicious! So good! It's sweet and 
tangy, and insanely tasty! I can chug this 
all day!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A jumbo-sized long cocktail infused with 
crisp, refreshing salted lychee...! I call 
it: 'Purification of the Flesh'!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It was obvious your body was craving 
electrolytes. I presume you were hard at 
training this morning as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you noticed!? I see... You didn't just 
make it 'feel like me,' you included what 
my body actually needed...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Gimlet-chan, what are you doing? 
Could this be... the rumored 
lunch-break-only bar?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you rest your wings a while? I 
shall uncover your one-and-only 
individuality."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Would someone "plain" like me really 
have something like that~?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If a person existed who was average 
in every single aspect, it creates the 
paradox where that itself becomes an 
intense individuality.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Taking all that into account, here is the 
cocktail. Shall we call it... 'The 
Flipside of Common Sense'?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is this... like a "Cassis Orange"? I don't 
really know much about real alcohol, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's the classic "drink everyone gets," 
right? Ah~ yeah, that does sound like 
something I'd pick...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, the true essence of fine wine 
lies in its taste... Take a sip, and your 
eyes shall be opened...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That ice is huge...! Plus it's so 
rich~. And it has this refreshing aroma...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The round ice slowly melts, altering the 
flavor. For someone as generous as you, an 
everlasting delight that goes beyond a 
long mocktail is fitting.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And! The secret medicinal herb will heal 
you, just like a leaf from Yggdrasil...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So nice, so soothing... Do I have some 
kind of individuality too, I wonder? 
Ehehe, that actually makes me kinda happy.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Every being possesses 'individuality.' If 
it seems absent, that is merely a failing 
on the part of the observer."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Only I can understand it, because I am 
unlike anyone else! It is my unique, 
sacred stigmata, noble and proud beyond 
all measure!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho... so you're the next customer, 
Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Could I get a cup, please?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. Are you also a lost lamb in 
search of your own unique flavor?
choice_data_list:
I want to experience that amazing skill 
for myself!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! In all the time we've spent 
together, I like to think I've grasped 
your tastes in food. You can look forward 
to it...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let me see through to your truth! I shall 
intoxicate you to your heart's content...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
âI see it! This is it! The single cup 
that truly embodies youuu!
choice_data_list: (I see... I'm being seen right through...)

text_block_list.text:
It was a flavor very much reminiscent of 
Gimlet. It was the perfect mocktail for 
me, intoxicated by her from the closest 
vantage point...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Technique, is it...? Heh-heh...! Indeed, 
one cannot pull this off without a trained 
eye. It doesn't feel bad to be praised for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We're closing up soon, but here's a 
special treat on the house. Let us share 
the same drink together.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nothing much, I just wanted to drink down 
a mocktail inspired by you myself.

A strangely nostalgic, pleasant flavor... 
Apparently, this is my "individuality." I 
felt like I had understood another piece 
of her aesthetic.
